angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 667,872 km at 174.54 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.7294 +/- 0.0187 mas (same row, RUWE 1.09): 174.54 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.96 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Hellier et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-130 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract): 667,872 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.04 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Hellier et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-130 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5625 +/- 90 K from Hellier et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-130 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hellier et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-130 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-130.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.491, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-130 (pscomppars): spectral type G6, from Hellier et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-41 7923: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-130 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.26 dex, from Hellier et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-130 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.03215, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-130 (pscomppars): age 2 Gyr, from Hellier et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-130 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.5 km/s, from Hellier et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.465.3693H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
